> Research · Pipeliners · 2026-06-23

# Summary
Search Atlas Keyword Researcher pull (Kim-Main browser) for the first June blog pillar. US national volumes; competition is Search Atlas "Competitor Pressure".

# Key numbers
- Broad: cipp lining 4,400 (27), trenchless pipe repair 3,600 (14), sewer pipe lining 2,400 (8), epoxy pipe lining 720 (15), pipe lining cost 320 (16), cast iron pipe replacement 260 (9).
- Local/commercial: commercial plumbing phoenix 260 (CPC $83.80), commercial sewer line repair 140, trenchless sewer repair phoenix 90, slab leak repair phoenix 50, hoa sewer line repair 23; several commercial and Phoenix terms at 0-10.

# Decisions
- Post 1 primary keyphrase: **sewer pipe lining** (2,400, competition 8), chosen by Kim on 2026-06-23. See [Pipeliners - Blog - Sewer Pipe Lining Pillar](lib:brain-pipeliners-blog-sewer-pipe-lining-pillar).
- Cannibalization watch: /what-is-cipp/, the lining-vs-replacement post and /epipe-restoration/.
- Future candidates: epoxy pipe lining, pipe lining cost, cast iron pipe replacement, commercial plumbing phoenix, slab leak repair phoenix.

# Notes
The file says to cross-check in the "Pipeliners Ads account 1401013750"; that ID is Summit. Pipeliners is 7219095860 (handoff conflict list). "Sewer pipe lining" as a focus phrase predates the rule against using "pipe lining" in new focus keywords.
